title: Data and Code for Confidence Sets for Reflection Order From a Multi-RIS Cascade Tensor
description: Simulation data, receiver and verification code, and the inputs and outputs for Tables I and II and Figure 1 of the manuscript Confidence Sets for Reflection Order From a Multi-RIS Cascade Tensor. The release includes 10,800 mixed-grid channel trials, 12,000 repeated acquisitions on six fixed channels, and a seven-level perturbation sweep on 600 paired base channels. Reuse requires citation of this version as specified in LICENSE.txt.
